column1: # The frameworks of the sweep with no shard whose headers declare nothing of their own (ruling 3a, 4; review of v-gen's open points).
# Each row: name, class, target, reason (TAB separated). class: alias (the declarations are another framework's, a link or a re-export),
# umbrella (the header includes other frameworks, which hold the declarations), placeholder (the header includes Foundation or nothing),
# empty (the header has no code), macros (macros only), metal (Metal shading language, guarded out of an Objective-C or C parse).
# target: the framework(s) whose shards hold the declarations, or - when they are none of the sweep's. Measured: decls census own=0.
